params.body:
**Triage proposal** (asked by the owner on 23 October 2026; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: Editorial should be able to create a test account on gentells.com for someone, with a plan and a trial, and get a link to share, without a developer.

Today the Accounts page in the Observatory manages accounts that already exist on gentells.com: plan, trial, Observatory access, block, delete. Creating one is not possible: a person has to register on the site first. For a prospect or a client who should try Gentells, editorial has no way to set up the account and hand it over.

Asked:

- create an account on gentells.com from the Accounts page: name, email address, plan, trial length;
- get a link to share with that person, which lets them set their own password and sign in (and a mail with the same link when mail is configured);
- see which accounts were made this way, so test accounts can be found and ended later.

Shape: a signed internal route on the site (`POST /internal/accounts`, next to the update and delete routes, same signature) that creates the user, sets plan and trial, marks the account as made by editorial, and returns a set-password link (the existing password reset token, with a longer life); a pipeline route that forwards it for admins; a form on the Accounts page that shows the link to copy. Nobody's password passes through the Observatory.
params.title: Create test accounts on gentells.com from the Accounts page and share a sign-in link
